<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:background="@color/background_primary"
    android:fitsSystemWindows="true">

    <ScrollView
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:clipToPadding="false"
        android:fillViewport="true"
        android:paddingStart="14dp"
        android:paddingTop="12dp"
        android:paddingEnd="14dp"
        android:paddingBottom="24dp"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent">

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:orientation="vertical">

            <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginBottom="12dp"
                app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/card_background"
                app:cardCornerRadius="18dp"
                app:cardElevation="0dp"
                app:strokeColor="@color/stroke_dark"
                app:strokeWidth="1dp">

                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:orientation="vertical"
                    android:padding="16dp">

                    <TextView
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:text="@string/smart_calibration_title"
                        android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                        android:textSize="24sp"
                        android:textStyle="bold" />

                    <TextView
                        android:id="@+id/tvSmartCalibrationProfile"
                        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_marginTop="6dp"
                        android:textColor="@color/accent_color"
                        android:textSize="13sp"
                        android:textStyle="bold" />

                    <TextView
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_marginTop="8dp"
                        android:text="@string/smart_calibration_intro"
                        android:textColor="@color/text_secondary"
                        android:textSize="12sp" />
                </LinearLayout>
            </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

            <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginBottom="12dp"
                app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/card_background"
                app:cardCornerRadius="18dp"
                app:cardElevation="0dp"
                app:strokeColor="@color/stroke_dark"
                app:strokeWidth="1dp">

                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:orientation="vertical"
                    android:padding="16dp">

                    <TextView
                        android:id="@+id/tvSmartCalibrationStatus"
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                        android:textSize="15sp"
                        android:textStyle="bold" />

                    <TextView
                        android:id="@+id/tvSmartCalibrationHint"
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_marginTop="6dp"
                        android:textColor="@color/text_secondary"
                        android:textSize="12sp" />

                    <TextView
                        android:id="@+id/tvSmartCalibrationDetails"
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_marginTop="6dp"
                        android:textColor="@color/text_tertiary"
                        android:textSize="12sp" />

                    <ProgressBar
                        android:id="@+id/progressSmartCalibration"
                        style="?android:attr/progressBarStyleHorizontal"
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="10dp"
                        android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
                        android:max="100"
                        android:progress="0" />

                    <LinearLayout
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:layout_marginTop="12dp"
                        android:orientation="horizontal">

                        <Button
                            android:id="@+id/btnSmartCalibrationStart"
                            android:layout_width="0dp"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_weight="1"
                            android:text="@string/smart_calibration_start" />

                        <Button
                            android:id="@+id/btnSmartCalibrationClear"
                            android:layout_width="0dp"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_marginStart="8dp"
                            android:layout_weight="1"
                            android:text="@string/smart_calibration_clear" />
                    </LinearLayout>
                </LinearLayout>
            </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>

        </LinearLayout>
    </ScrollView>

</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>
